mapper.select: SELECT initial_sync_completed FROM sys_integration_state WHERE connection_code = 'EHR'
SELECT FROM sys_employee WHERE mobile_hash = #{mobileHash} AND employment_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT e.id, e.employee_no, e.display_name, e.primary_org_id, e.employment_status, e.account_status, e.authz_version FROM sys_employee e INNER JOIN sys_external_identity i ON i.employee_id = e.id WHERE i.provider_type = 'WECHAT' AND i.provider_tenant = #{appId} AND i.provider_subject_hash = #{subjectHash} AND i.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.employee_no, e.display_name, e.primary_org_id AS organization_id, e.employment_status, e.account_status, e.authz_version, c.password_hash, c.status AS credential_status, c.must_change_password FROM sys_employee e INNER JOIN sys_local_credential c ON c.employee_id = e.id WHERE e.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_external_identity (id, employee_id, provider_type, provider_tenant, provider_subject_hash, provider_subject_ciphertext, union_subject_hash, union_subject_ciphertext, status, bound_mobile_hash, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{identityId}, #{employeeId}, 'WECHAT', #{appId}, #{subjectHash}, #{subjectCiphertext}, #{unionHash}, #{unionCiphertext}, 'ACTIVE', #{mobileHash}, #{now}, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO sys_role_assignment (id, employee_id, role_id, scope_type, scope_value, status, created_at) SELECT #{roleAssignmentId}, #{employeeId}, r.id, 'SELF', #{scopeValue}, 'ACTIVE', #{now} FROM sys_role r WHERE r.role_code = 'EMPLOYEE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_assignment a WHERE a.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND a.role_id = r.id AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_role_assignment a INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = a.role_id WHERE a.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.role_code

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_role_assignment a INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = a.role_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE a.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.target_service = #{targetService} ORDER BY p.permission_code
SELECT DISTINCT a.scope_type, a.scope_value FROM sys_role_assignment a WHERE a.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.scope_type, a.scope_value
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_session (id, employee_id, client_type, auth_method, status, authz_version_at_issue, absolute_expires_at, idle_expires_at, last_seen_at, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{employeeId}, #{clientType}, #{authMethod}, 'ACTIVE', #{authzVersion}, #{absoluteExpiresAt}, #{idleExpiresAt}, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO sys_refresh_token (id, session_id, token_family_id, token_hash, parent_token_id, status, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{sessionId}, #{familyId}, #{hash}, #{parentId}, 'ACTIVE', #{expiresAt}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, token_family_id, status, expires_at FROM sys_refresh_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE sys_refresh_token SET status = 'REVOKED' WHERE token_family_id = #{familyId} AND status <> 'REVOKED'
